_meta.notes: Describes the spec JSON that grill.py check, render and accept read. JSON Schema draft-07 shape, plus x-checks listing the rules that check enforces beyond structure. Errors make check exit 1; warnings only with --strict.

title.description: Short name of the thing being built.

type.description: Project type ids from question-bank.json (website, app, automation, ...). Several allowed.

goal.description: One sentence: what this does and for whom.

success.description: What someone can observe or measure to say it worked. A number, a time, or an action a person can do.

users.description: Who uses or reads it, and in what context or device.

accept.description: A test anyone can run: what you do and what you must see. Not 'works well'.

nice_to_have.description: Built only if time remains, after every must-have passes.

out_of_scope.description: Things that look related but will not be built.

constraints.description: Deadline, budget, tools, brand rules, platform.

from.description: Question id the guess replaces, or 'inferred'.

risk.description: Cost if the guess is wrong.

assumptions.description: Guesses the build relies on. Shown to the user as 'Correct me before I build'.

reject_if.description: Conditions under which the user sends it back. Each becomes a line in the acceptance run.

open_risks.description: Known unknowns that could change the build later.

error: must_have item without a testable accept
success not observable (no number, time or action)
same term in must_have and out_of_scope
goal is more than one sentence
assumption risk not low, med or high
